terms.definition: The total distance around a shape, equal to the sum of its sides.
terms.whyItMatters: Perimeter is the measurement of every wrapped edge.

terms.definition: One straight edge of a polygon.
terms.function: Each side adds its length to the total.
terms.whyItMatters: The perimeter is built from every side.

terms.definition: The path going along the edge and back to the start.
terms.function: A way to picture the measurement.
terms.whyItMatters: Walking the edge turns perimeter into movement.

terms.definition: A side found by subtracting known sides from the total.
terms.whereItIs: Solved from the counter and other edges.
terms.whyItMatters: You can find one unknown side when you know the walk's total.
